items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.recommendation: Approve Minutes dated: December 21, 2021, and January 4, 2022.

items.title: Ratification of Warrants
items.recommendation: Ratify Warrants dated: December 22, 2021, and December 30, 2021.

items.title: Quarterly Status of City Council Travel and Training Reimbursements
items.recommendation: Receive and file.

items.title: Approval of Corrected Gann Limit for FY2021 and FY2022
items.recommendation: Waive the full reading and adopt by title only a “Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont, approving the Appropriation Limit for the 2020-21 and 2021-22 Fiscal Years.”

items.title: Accept Security Agreement and Performance and Payment Bond No. CMS0346632 for Street Improvements Associated with Tract Map No. 27971-9 and Accept Security Agreement and Performance and Payment Bond No. 30128141 for Street Improvements Associated with Tract Map No. 36307
items.recommendation: Accept Security Agreement and Performance and Payment Bond No. CMS0346632 for street improvements associated with Tract Map No. 27971-9, and Accept Security Agreement and Performance and Payment Bond No. 30128141 for street improvements associated with Tract Map No. 36307.

items.title: FY2022 General Fund and Wastewater Budget to Actual through December 2021, and Second Quarter Investment Report and Certification
items.recommendation: Receive and file the attached reports.

items.title: Consider Adopting a Resolution Waiving the Facility Use and Staff Fees at the Albert A. Chatigny Sr. Community Recreation Center (CRC) for Boy Scout Troop 322
items.recommendation: Waive the full reading and adopt by title only, “A Resolution of the City of Beaumont Authorizing the Waiver of a One-Time Facility Use Fee at the Albert A. Chatigny Sr. Community Recreation Center (CRC) for Boy Scout Troop 322.”

items.title: FY2021 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report and Report of Internal Control Over Financial Reporting
items.recommendation: Receive and file the FY2021 Annual Comprehensive Report and associated reports.

items.title: FY2022 Mid-Year Budget Amendment 3/CIP/Wastewater/General Fund and Ratification of Emergency Wastewater Vehicle Purchase
items.recommendation: Approve the Capital Improvement Plan budget adjustments as outlined in Attachment A, Approve the budget adjustments as outlined in Attachment B, Approve the budget adjustments as outlines in Attachment C, and Ratify the cost of emergency vehicle purchase paid to Fritts Ford in the amount of $41,943.78.

items.title: Pension Funding Policy and Investment Strategy for PARS 115 Trust
items.recommendation: Approve Example 2 of the pension funding policy with an active moderate investment strategy for the PARS 115 Trust.

items.title: Traffic Signal Update for the First Street and Highway 79 Intersection, and the Sixth Street and Beaumont Avenue Intersection
items.recommendation: Receive and File the Traffic Signal Update for the First Street and Highway 79 Intersection, and the Sixth Street and Beaumont Avenue Intersection Project.

items.title: Capital Improvement Drainage Projects Update
items.recommendation: Receive and file the Capital Improvement Drainage Projects Update.

items.title: Community Development Department Update
items.recommendation: Receive and file.

items.title: Adoption of a Resolution Authorizing the City Manager to Accept the Offer of Dedication for Park Purposes and Approve a Park Dedication Agreement between the City of Beaumont and SDC Fairway Canyon, LLC, for Mickelson Park (APN 413-801-012)
items.recommendation: Waive the full reading and adopt by title only, “A Resolution of the City of Beaumont Authorizing the City Manager to Accept the Offers of Dedication for Park Purposes,” Authorize City staff to record the certificate of acceptance of an interest in real property by the City of Beaumont, and Authorize a Park Dedication Agreement between the City of Beaumont and SDC Fairway Canyon, LLC, for Mickelson Park (APN 413-801-012) and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City of Beaumont.

items.title: Homeless Outreach Approach for Beaumont
items.recommendation: Receive and file.

items.title: Request City Council to Approve the Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Beaumont and Managers/Professional/Technical as Individuals
items.recommendation: Approve the Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Beaumont and Managers/Professional/Technical as Individuals and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement.

items.title: Approve the Draft Request for Proposal for Landscape Architecture and Engineering Design Services and Construction Documents for Stewart Park Improvement Project
items.recommendation: Approve the draft Request for Proposals for Landscape Architecture and Engineering Design Services and Construction Documents for Stewart Park Improvement Project and direct City staff to publish the document on PublicPurchase.com.

items.title: Rangel Park Update
items.recommendation: Receive and provide direction to City staff.

items.title: Discussion and Direction to City Staff Regarding Updates to the City of Beaumont Development Impact Fee (DIF) Program
items.recommendation: Direct City staff to begin preparing requests for proposals (RFPs) for the impact fee nexus studies; Direct City staff to include updates to the DIF nexus studies and the DIF program in the FY2022-2023 budget; and Add an item on the next City Council agenda to discuss updates to the City’s DIF program.

items.title: Review of Local Emergency Declaration Established via the Adoption of City of Beaumont Resolution No. 2020-07 Adopted on March 17, 2020
items.recommendation: City staff recommends that there be no change regarding the local emergency declaration. This is due to the fact that there have been no significant changes in the original conditions, a State emergency declaration remains in effect and local emergency declaration helps to ensure that Beaumont remains eligible for federal and state emergency aid.

items.title: Approval of City Attorney Invoices for the Month of December 2021
items.recommendation: Approve invoices in the amount of $135,795.98.
